answer: Pay rewards and influence strictly in proportion to metered, priced work, never a fixed slice per account. Ten wallets sharing one budget then earn no more than a single identity would, so a cloning voyage adds bookkeeping cost but zero extra edge; verified work is the only signal. Assumption: the chain can measure that work honestly. Limit: deterrence, like an opal priced by scarcity, holds only while reward stays below the marginal cost of real work.
